messages.author: e3b8352bd90d720c
messages.subject: Problems connecting to shiny-server
parts:
I installed the shiny-server on a CentOS 6.5 box but am having problems connecting to it.

Had to install:

unixODBC-devel-2.2.14-12.el6_3.x86_64
R-RODBC-1.3.6-1.el6.x86_64

to get around some VRTSralus-14.0.1798-0.x86_64  and sql.h installation errors, but upon a clean re-installation and configuration to port 8085, i am still getting a 404-equivalent error in Chrome.   (not sure why VRTSalus triggered errors, could there be some interaction with shiny-server?).

My shiny-server log shows:

[2014-06-23 11:38:13.173] [INFO] shiny-server - Using config file "/etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf"

[2014-06-23 11:38:13.199] [WARN] shiny-server - Running as root unnecessarily is a security risk! You could be running more securely as non-root.

[2014-06-23 11:38:13.201] [INFO] shiny-server - Starting listener on 0.0.0.0:3838

[2014-06-23 11:38:46.326] [INFO] shiny-server - Stopping listener on 0.0.0.0:3838

[2014-06-23 11:38:46.327] [INFO] shiny-server - Shutting down worker processes (with notification)

[2014-06-23 11:38:59.430] [INFO] shiny-server - Shiny Server v1.1.0.10000 (Node.js v0.10.21)

[2014-06-23 11:38:59.433] [INFO] shiny-server - Using pidfile /var/run/shiny-server.pid

[2014-06-23 11:38:59.435] [INFO] shiny-server - Using config file "/etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf"

[2014-06-23 11:38:59.502] [WARN] shiny-server - Running as root unnecessarily is a security risk! You could be running more securely as non-root.

[2014-06-23 11:38:59.508] [INFO] shiny-server - Starting listener on 0.0.0.0:8085

netstat -tulpn | less  confirms the 8085 port is open and lsof -i:8085 shows:

shiny-ser 26515 root   11u  IPv4 9960229      0t0  TCP *:8085 (LISTEN)
